description: The one failure table (Phase 15 Failure matrix and Navigation/Refusal overlays). sign_in keys are SignInOutcome kinds the shell renders; overlay keys are what the native machine window shows. Placeholders: {host} {machine} {email} {domain} {code}. Every surface reads its own copy and a test pins it to this file, word for word.

declined.message: You chose Cancel on the sign-in page, so this phone wasn't signed in.

interrupted.message: The app was closed while you were signing in, so that sign-in can't finish. Start it again.

verification_failed.message: This copy of the app couldn't prove it owns the sign-in link for {domain}. Install the app from an official channel, or try again later.

rate_limited.message: Too many sign-ins in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

protocol_unsupported.message: This app and {host} don't speak the same protocol version. Update whichever side is older, then try again.

clock_skewed.message: This phone's clock is more than five minutes off from {host}, so the sign-in was refused. Set the clock automatically and try again.

device_key_rejected.message: The sign-in page refused this request ({code}). Update the app.

refused.message: The sign-in page refused this request ({code}). Update the app.

no_browser.message: Install or enable a browser (Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Vanadium…) to sign in.

mismatch.message: That sign-in reply didn't match a sign-in from this phone, so it was ignored.

decrypt_failed.message: The sign-in reply couldn't be decrypted. Update the app and yaran on the machine.

envelope_expired.message: The sign-in reply had already expired. Check that this phone's clock is right, then try again.

offline.message: No connection. Check your network and try again.

tls_error.message: The connection to {host} isn't secure, so the app stopped.

vault_locked.message: Unlock the app to sign in.

keys_unavailable.message: yaran on {machine} can't reach Cloudflare's key service, so signing in again won't help. Try again in a minute.

unavailable.message: yaran on {machine} is temporarily unavailable, so signing in again won't help. Try again in a minute.

host_disconnected.message: {machine} is no longer connected to the cloud. Check yaran cloud status on the machine.

offline.message: {machine} is offline or its tunnel isn't connected

tls_error.message: The connection to {host} isn't secure, so the app stopped.

banner.message: Your session for {machine} ends in 10 minutes

download_refused.message: Downloads aren't supported in the app. Open it in the yaran web UI on your computer.

renderer_crashed.message: The page crashed and was reloaded
